mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`booklist`(id, user_id, title, summary, cover_image, visibility, like_count, collect_count, book_count) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{coverImage}, #{visibility}, #{likeCount}, #{collectCount}, #{bookCount})
mapper.select: select * from booknest.`booklist` where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update booknest.`booklist` set user_id = #{userId}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, visibility = #{visibility}, like_count = #{likeCount}, collect_count = #{collectCount}, book_count = #{bookCount} where id = #{id}
